input.goal: Find the date of the 2026 Dublin Marathon. Search the web for "Dublin Marathon 2026 date", check the official site (dublinmarathon.ie) if possible, and report the exact date and day of the week.

content.text: [neutral] The 2026 Dublin Marathon is on Sunday 25 October, with a start at 8:45. That's six days from now, so you've got a week to decide whether you're running it or just cheering from the barrier. The date came from one web result, so check dublinmarathon.ie before you book anything.
